area: Canning Town north-east: Florence, Shepherd, Blanche and Chargeable Streets, Sutton, Union, Luton, Philip, Garfield, Mayfield, Ohio, Columbia, Croydon and Braemar Roads, Star Lane, Church Street and the Barking Road (tramway) with Zion Gospel Hall and the Smithy
method: sheet tool; 9 sweep crops at 2x, each anchored on opening (r0c0 FLORENCE / SHEPHERD / BLANCHE STREET; r0c1 CHARGEABLE STREET / SUTTON ROAD; r0c2 UNION ROAD / LUTON ROAD / PHILIP STREET; r1c0 GARFIELD / MAYFIELD ROAD, Mission Church; r1c1 CROYDON ROAD / BRAEMAR; r1c2 CROYDON / BRAEMAR ROAD; r2c0 STAR LANE / CHURCH STREET / Chapel; r2c1 Zion Gospel Hall / Smithy / BARKING lettering; r2c2 BARKING ROAD / STAR LANE / P.H.). Contact sheets e1 and e2 (8x +-18), e3 and e4 (12x +-13/14), e5 and e7 (6x +-26 pheon and dot search), e6 and e8 (22x +-6, doubtful digits against known 3, 5, 6 and 8 on this sheet). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened. Dots from a centroid helper (overridden where it snapped to a letter), checked on a marker sheet.
legibility: Clear engraving but dense street lettering with interpuncts; several figures sit beside interpuncts (medium). No sheet join seen by eye; the sheet tool reports none. At 22x the italic 5s close up like 6s, so 5/6 was judged at 8-12x against the flat-topped 5s of the same sheet.
